author: N6rL
content: Rust core contract types complete. Modules: error.rs (LibraryError, ProjectionError, SynthesisError via thiserror); raw_document.rs (RawDocument<T> typestate with Unvalidated/Validated markers, all component types mirroring Python schema v1, deny_unknown_fields on all membrane types, try_from_json() constructor with schema_version + content_hash validation); knowledge_object.rs (KnowledgeObjectId UUID newtype, KnowledgeObject, Enrichment); library.rs (Library trait, IdentityResult enum with boxed VersionUpdate, LibraryQuery); projection.rs (Projection trait with render/rebuild); synthesis.rs (SynthesisService trait, register axes as #[derive(Default)] enums, SynthesisConfig, SynthesisArtifact, TokenCounts); job.rs (Job, JobId UUID newtype, JobStatus with serde tag, path helpers, is_terminal()); lib.rs (pub mod + re-exports). All clean: cargo clippy -D warnings, cargo test, cargo fmt. Schema v1 defined on both sides of membrane.
